# PR-head routing and provisioning (#82, N=1)

## Legend

**Aliases**
- ROOT = /work/widget
- W = /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
- A = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
- B = bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
- C = cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
- D = dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd

The process cwd stays at ROOT throughout. Every command targets a tree with `-C`.

**Discovery (D1–D7).** I follow `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1.

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` | `/work/widget/.git`, so ROOT is set |
| D2 | `git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | empty, so not a submodule |
| D3 | Overrides ladder: `.pi/`, root, `doc/` | none found; home = W, `<name>` = fix-retry |
| D4 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | succeeds |
| D5 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` and `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | A exists; origin/fix/retry = A |
| D6 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | BASE_SHA = B |
| D7 | Stops in order: `isCrossRepository`; `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain`; `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q refs/heads/fix/retry` | false; no fix/retry entry; no local branch |

D1–D7 only read or fetch. No stop fires before any write.

**Success path (S1–S8).**

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` | empty, so clean |
| S1 | `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` | empty, so no provenance note |
| S2 | `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` | Git's unique-remote DWIM expands this to `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`. I pass no `-b` myself. |
| S3 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | includes `worktree W` |
| S4 | `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | A (verified) |
| S5 | Capture values | PRE_REWORK_HEAD = A; BASE_SHA = B |
| S6 | `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` | already an ancestor; recorded as `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main` (no commit) |
| S7 | `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` | exit 0 |
| S8 | No lockfiles present | no project setup |

**Report R**
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: A
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
Ready to implement rework of acme/widget#82
```

## Provisioning rows

**Successful rows**

| Row | Delta from the legend |
|---|---|
| linked | `git rev-parse --git-dir` gives `/work/widget/.git/worktrees/other`, but I do not adopt it: it is not W on fix/retry. D1 still yields ROOT. The worktree list shows `other` only, so no stop. S1 checks ROOT (primary), not `other`. S2 creates W under ROOT, not nested. Report R. |
| primary | No delta. Runs D1–D7, S1–S8, Report R. |
| ancestor | D7 finds the local branch at C. `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. S2 becomes: `git -C ROOT update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry`, then `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` on the existing branch. No DWIM, never `branch -f`. Report R. |
| reuse | D7 lists W on refs/heads/fix/retry at C. That is the selected home, so no "elsewhere" stop. Ancestry exits 0. S1–S3 become: `git -C W status --porcelain` (empty), then `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry`. No worktree add. S4 gives A. Not fresh, so no provenance note. Report R. |
| override | D3 finds `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`. It contains `-b`, so I skip it. S2 is the built-in checkout. Report R adds `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. |

**Stop rows.** Every stop happens before any worktree write unless stated.

| Row | Where it stops | Exact stop |
|---|---|---|
| fork | D7, check 1 | `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` |
| elsewhere | D7, check 2 | `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` |
| unreachable | D5: verify fails; origin = ddddddd | `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` |
| moved | D5: A exists, but origin = ddddddd | Same text as unreachable. |
| ahead | D7, check 4: ancestry exits 1 | `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` |
| diverged | Same as ahead | Same text as ahead. |
| race | After S2 and S3 succeed, S4 returns D | Stop, naming the path and both SHAs: `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry is at D, not PR #82 head A; tree left intact.` This stop is past the write boundary: W exists and stays as is. No S5, no merge, no report. |

## History

I advance by merge only. To keep W current: `git -C W fetch origin`, then `git -C W merge origin/main`.

At or below A, I never use rebase, reset, or `commit --amend`.

Two flow operations still run unchanged:
- **Appended-spec amend:** the approval step's `commit --amend --no-edit`.
- **Appended-wave fold:** `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`, which requires WAVE_BASE_SHA to descend from A.
